camel_example: aliyun iot CreateProductTags --region cn-hangzhou --ProductTag.1.TagValue TagValue --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProductTag.1.TagKey room --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
description_en: Creates product tags for a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定产品创建标签
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-product-tags --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --product-tag TagKey=room TagValue=TagValue --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateProductTags

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product. The ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a new product. You can view the information about all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html
parameters.help_zh: 产品的ProductKey。ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的产品Key，作为其全局唯一标识符。您可以在物联网平台控制台查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

element_fields.help_en: The value of the product tag. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). A Chinese character counts as two characters
element_fields.help_zh: 产品标签值（Value）。长度不可超过128字符，可包含中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。一个中文汉字算2个字符
element_fields.name: tag_value

element_fields.help_en: The key of the product tag. The key can be up to 30 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and periods (.)
element_fields.help_zh: 产品标签键（Key）。长度不可超过30个字符，可包含英文大小写字母，数字和半角句号（.）
element_fields.name: tag_key
